channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: tapflow — via awesome-mac
item.description: Self-hosted tool for testing iOS simulators and Android emulators from the browser, on Macs your team already owns.

item.title: Vauta — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source meeting notes app that transcribes any call on device, tells speakers apart and writes cited minutes with Apple Intelligence or your own local model server.

item.title: Uptick — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app updater that finds updates from the App Store, Sparkle, Electron feeds and Homebrew, and verifies each download before installing.

item.title: Swamp Converter — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar file converter: drag a file, tap a key and drop it on a wheel to convert video, audio, images and PDFs.

item.title: Show Desktop — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that hides every window with one click or a shortcut, then brings them all back exactly as they were.

item.title: Safelight — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app that schedules the color filter, brightness, and Light/Dark appearance, fading the screen to deep red at night.

item.title: Rebind — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool for remapping keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures to shortcuts and system actions.

item.title: RAVE LIVE — via awesome-mac
item.description: Festival light show that locks to the beat of whatever your Mac is playing, with stage lights, lasers and MilkDrop presets.

item.title: Pulse — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar system monitor with live CPU, memory, temperature, fan, network, disk, power, and battery stats.

item.title: Mudroom — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app and CLI that runs coding agents like Claude Code and Codex in a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, then lets you review and apply their changes like a pull request.

item.title: Matcha — via awesome-mac
item.description: Keep your Mac awake with a visual timer, a floating badge, and detection of AI coding agents.

item.title: Lucid — via awesome-mac
item.description: Live 4K wallpapers with moving space, nature and ocean loops on every display, plus Apple Aerials.

item.title: Glass — via awesome-mac
item.description: Low-latency remote desktop for Mac and Linux that you view from any browser, with nothing to install on the viewing device.

item.title: Flickbar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source window manager driven by trackpad gestures on window title bars.

item.title: ContainerDesk — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native SwiftUI workspace for Apple's container runtime, with live resource monitoring and an integrated terminal.

item.title: Burrow — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free, open-source native app for the Mole cleaner: clean caches, uninstall apps and the leftovers of deleted ones, map the disk and watch system health, all through Mole's safety checks.

item.title: Bedrock Launcher — via awesome-mac
item.description: Play your own copy of Minecraft Bedrock Edition for Windows on Apple Silicon, fully offline, through a locally built WineGDK with DXMT.

item.title: Apolo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source image optimizer that compresses and converts to WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, JPEG and PNG, showing the loss and its SSIMULACRA 2 score before saving.

item.title: AerialSwap — via awesome-mac
item.description: Turn any video into a native Aerial wallpaper for the lock screen and desktop, in its own group in System Settings.

item.title: AI Meter — via awesome-mac
item.description: Shows your remaining Claude Code or Codex usage and reset time in the menu bar.

item.title: Çentik — via awesome-mac
item.description: Turns the MacBook notch into a live island for music, system stats, an AI chat with your own Claude, Gemini or Ollama, clipboard history and meeting alerts.

item.title: UMST — via awesome-mac
item.description: Desktop calendar widget that brings together Google, iCloud, Outlook, Apple Reminders, Canvas and other LMS deadlines, Todoist, Asana and Trello, with menu bar quick add.

item.title: Splat — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native macOS Markdown editor in Rust where both the source and the live preview are editable.

item.title: Shandian — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native download manager that handles magnet links, torrents, HTTP files and videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu in one window, with browser download takeover and stream-while-downloading (Chinese UI).

item.title: SATF — via awesome-mac
item.description: Shake a file while dragging it to convert, merge into a PDF, zip, or extract it from a radial menu under your cursor.

item.title: Qingo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Cache cleaner that recognizes 60+ video, design and AI tools (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe apps, Cursor, Claude Code and more), clears only caches that rebuild automatically, and moves them to the Trash with undo, leaving projects and conversations untouched (Chinese UI).

item.title: PullBull — via awesome-mac
item.description: GitHub pull requests, issues and Projects boards in the menu bar.

item.title: Open Contexts — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source window switcher with a persistent app bar and saved window groups.

item.title: Monny — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar system monitor with process lookup and a battery charge limit.

item.title: Mac Monitor — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight menu bar monitor for RAM, CPU, network and disk, focused on memory pressure.

item.title: Lumilo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app that runs Splash or llama.cpp servers, shows memory and token speed, and downloads models from Hugging Face.

item.title: JUMP — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool that labels every clickable element so you can click, scroll and search any app from the keyboard.

item.title: Clipivo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local-first native clipboard manager that keeps your clipboard history searchable, organized, and private.

item.title: Amical — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source AI dictation and note-taking app that types into any app and formats the text for the app you are in, using local Whisper or Parakeet models.

item.title: ghostty-designer — via awesome-mac
item.description: Live-preview editor for Ghostty themes, fonts and UI settings.

item.title: Prism — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source download manager that splits files into parallel connections, catches browser downloads, and saves videos.

item.title: HideNotch — via awesome-mac
item.description: Paints the menu bar black on notched MacBooks so the notch blends in, with optional rounded screen corners.

item.title: Yardlet — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app for running Codex, Claude Code and other coding agent CLIs side by side in one window, using each agent's own sign-in and session history.

item.title: Tercana — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar companion for PS5 Remote Play: live on-device subtitle translation into any language, plus a PSN trophy tracker.

item.title: SwaprTrans — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight (<2MB) native menu bar tool for select-and-space translation and in-place Enter rewrite, powered by Apple's on-device model.

item.title: Stash — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar icon hider for macOS 27 that collapses status items behind a single arrow.

item.title: Hey Mac — via awesome-mac
item.description: On-device face unlock for the lock screen and privacy shields for selected apps.

item.title: HTS for Mac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Read-only Korean and US stock workspace in the style of Windows HTS apps, with a 10-level order book, four-chart layouts, watchlists and saved workspaces; live quotes need your own Kiwoom REST API key.

item.title: Glint — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source screenshot tool that finds and pixelates emails, IBANs, card numbers, and API keys on-device before you share.

item.title: Anthora — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local photo and video library for browsing, searching, and reviewing duplicates across folders and mounted drives.

item.title: Tidymint — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source disk cleaner that only moves items to the Trash and checks whether your project scripts still reference a duplicate before removing it.

item.title: Tamka — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source on-device dictation that runs NVIDIA Parakeet models on the Neural Engine and types at the cursor in any app.

item.title: StableBar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Customizable menu bar replacement with themes, widgets, popups and AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces.

item.title: Photon — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source screenshot, markup and screen recording tool for macOS and Windows, with no network code.

item.title: ParrotFlow — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local dictation app that you can program with your rules, scripts, and vocabulary.
